lines.t: Who is a wise and faithful servant?
Is he not one who receives the blessings of his Father without constraint?
One who embraces my speech, whether soft or hard, even of that which I have spoken to another.
For he knows that every good gift and every perfect gift is from above and comes down from the Father of lights.
With whom there is no variation or shadow of turning as it is written.
beloved one if i am he who reigns in your heart the one of whom you testify is love and mercy
the one alone who knows all things why do you resist my correction and seek only to embrace
If I speak and my words carry my spirit, but no difference between them for everything
which comes from the mouth of the Lord, your God is a blessing for all, a song for all
those who have ears to hear.
A vision to all who have eyes to see my splendor
Painted by the word of my glory, an overflowing fountain
Inside those whose hearts are wide open
Beloved, it is time for you to truly believe without seeing
To obey my voice, whether soft or hard
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, it is time for you to follow your heart and no more bow to the demands of your heart.
It is time to embrace me as I truly am.
Beloved one, if I am he who reigns in your heart,
The one of whom you testify is love and mercy
The one alone who knows all things
Why do you resist my correction
And seek only to embrace that which is soft?
If I speak
And my words carry my spirit
Put no difference between them
For everything which comes from the mouth
The Lord your God is a blessing for all, says the Lord.
Oh, oh, oh.
